name: team
description: Orchestrates specialized agents to autonomously implement entire features end-to-end

interface.shortDescription: Autonomous feature pipeline: question, research, design, plan, implement, PR.
interface.longDescription: Team turns a feature description into a reviewed pull request. It walks an eight-phase pipeline — worktree, question, research, design, structure, plan, implement, PR — dispatching a specialist agent at each phase and persisting every artifact to disk. An adversarial design review gates the design and five reviewers gate the implementation, so the only human checkpoint is the pull request at the end.
defaultPrompt: Investigate why this code was written this way.
Review the open comments on this pull request.
